Eel-Weir Yields No Eels and Two Slivers; Eel-Men Say That Is Not How Weirs Work
dispatches.body: Skalle waded the silt flats at low tide and came back with green in a jar and a story about a bone with teeth marks that nobody will hear twice. Skalle did not need the lantern on the flats. That was the trouble. Nobody needed a lantern. A barge slipped its mooring at midnight and was found upstream. Upstream.

Agnar Watches the Pit More Than Fights It; Pit Unbothered
dispatches.body: Agnar took a bout at the Pit and took a bruise for it. The crowd was fair. The crowd is never fair. The stars were out. All of them.

dispatches.headline: Hilde Returns Empty-Handed; Blames the Stones
dispatches.body: Hilde went into the cellars under the Pit and came back with dust, a cough, and nothing green. Someone had been through the cellars under the Pit already, in a hurry, owing money. It rained until the third hour.
